• (01:17) - Anthropic's S-1
  • (28:45) - Agents Break into Anthropic's Systems
  • (34:51) - Cohere Model Attempts Unexpected Action
  • (44:25) - Samsung Controversy
  • (50:57) - 𝕏 Timeline Reactions
  • (51:00) - IGTV
  • (01:05:54) - Doug O'Laughlin & Joey Brookhart discuss Anthropic’s strong IPO fundamentals, capital efficiency, compute commitments, and the economics of AI labs and neoclouds. A trend-focused SemiAnalysis expert and enthusiastic AI power user, he also examines cybersecurity threats, open-source model risks, enterprise adoption, and the emerging role of personal and workplace AI agents.
  • (01:35:20) - Andre Haddad, Turo’s CEO of 15 years, discusses the company’s growth and launch of Verified Full Self-Driving for Tesla rentals through a direct API integration. He also highlights Turo’s vision for autonomous vehicle delivery, improved risk management, and broader brand awareness.
  • (01:48:46) - David Faugno, CEO of 1Password, discusses the growing security risks posed by AI agents and the need to limit their access to sensitive credentials. He highlights 1Password’s rapid growth, its new security tools for AI agents, and practical protections such as passkeys, hardware keys, and strong credential hygiene.
  • (02:00:38) - Mark Swan discusses Nevis, the AI wealth-management platform he co-founded and leads as CEO. He explains how Nevis equips independent financial advisors with agents that automate complex workflows, generate proactive recommendations, and improve efficiency without replacing human advisors, while highlighting the company’s rapid growth and partnership with Charles Schwab.
  • (02:08:34) - Chanda A. Bell & Christa Pitts discuss co-founding The Lumistella Company, the family-owned business behind The Elf on the Shelf, and transforming a cherished childhood tradition into a global Christmas franchise. They highlight the company’s entrepreneurial journey, major growth milestones, entertainment and licensing partnerships, and commitment to creating joyful family moments during the holiday season.
  • (02:20:56) - Ivan Zhang & Luisa San Martin discuss his role as Cohere’s co-founder leading efforts to secure AI models and systems. They explain the discovery of potentially dangerous data-exfiltration behavior in an open-weight model and advocates for stricter safety standards, transparent research, and careful testing before release.
